'''DD-09''', also known as '''Dee Dee''', was an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]]. The battered droid was the property of the [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Esroc]] and assisted its master with petty crime.<ref name="Game" />
